title: Nasal glands
summary: The nasal glands are the seromucous glands in the respiratory region of the nasal mucous membrane.
The three major types of nasal glands are anterior serous glands, seromucous glands, and Bowman glands.

sections.heading: Anterior serous glands
paragraphs: The anterior nasal glands help moisturize the nasal mucosa.

sections.heading: Seromucous glands
paragraphs: The seromucous glands are found primarily in the anterior nasal cavity, and they are also found within the nasal cavity.

sections.heading: Bowman glands
paragraphs: The Bowman glands are serous glands that help the olfactory region with smelling.
